appSource.buildNote: Signed root APK built from the committed app source at appSource.commit.

notes: One ARM64 dual-entry effect driver supports the embedded AIDL Effect V4 interface and the legacy AELI factory entry.
Global Binder control is ldsp.control protocol 3. Audio effect UUIDs remain unchanged for effect attachment compatibility.
Native driver and helper are unchanged. Root universal app 1.7.1-beta-4/code 104 was built and signed locally from the committed app source on master.

The owner relayed tester confirmation that the preceding mixers-test-16 compatibility build worked with Bannerlator, Eden and NetherSX2. DuckStation and WhatsApp session coverage were reported working in preceding tests. These reports are not universal validation of all devices, firmware, routes, or the newly versioned APK.

The opt-in Xposed compatibility mode requests eligible effect-compatible AAudio, OpenSL ES and DirectAudio paths. It does not make the driver process arbitrary FAST tracks directly. Latency may increase and affected apps must be restarted after changing the setting.
